## Evidence retained honestly

Deposit20000; charges3000+3000; native cumulative3000→6000; finalized payout6000;
unused refund14000 test-USDC base units. Only TripDesk was funded. AgentPass and
HotelOps each produced two actual skips and incurred zero accepted charges.
Hypothetical funded competition, no-fill and failure/pending examples are separate.

Actual measured Jev attempts1241.38–1514.13ms; no low-latency or targeting-lift
claim. Organic answers came from isolated gpt-6.1-sol low app agents through an
operator-recorded bridge, not unattended CLI. ContextHint profiles include real
prompt-to-creative-ID associations and inferred hints; the captured profiles do
not contain original creative copy. Historical brands are not enrolled campaigns.

Original public signed receipt packets were reconstructed on later replay and
remain explicitly marked. Source profiles were captured from the already-running
Phase4 public bootstrap without a fresh lookup; their hashes match decisions.
Block time and local event time are separate clock domains. An owned-app receipt
is not attention, full reading, hidden-context absorption, endorsement or lift.
